# 2. Statistical Assessment of Water Service Providers in Kenya

### Project Overview

This project analyses the operational, financial, and service delivery performance of water service providers in Kenya, with particular attention to non-revenue water (NRW).

Using statistical methods in R, the study examines the distribution of NRW, relationships with selected operational and financial indicators, and differences between compliant and non-compliant water service providers.

### Statistical Methods

- Descriptive statistics
- Data quality assessment
- Data visualisation using `ggplot2`
- Pearson correlation analysis
- Wilcoxon rank-sum test

### Research Report

[📄 View / Download Report](files/water_performance_report.pdf){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

### Dataset and Reproducibility

The dataset is available for researchers, students, and other interested users through the following repositories.

- [**Access Dataset on GitHub**](https://github.com/Mwanja-collab/Kenya-Water-Performance) — view the repository and download the CSV file.
- [**Cite Dataset on Zenodo**](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23685035) — access the dataset's permanent DOI record.

# 3. Student Academic Performance Analysis

### Project Overview

This project analyses student academic performance using the Mathematics Student Performance dataset obtained from the UCI Machine Learning Repository. It examines demographic, family, educational, social and lifestyle characteristics associated with students' academic outcomes.

The study applies statistical methods to investigate factors associated with final examination grades and identify students who may be at risk of poor academic performance.

### Statistical Methods

- Descriptive statistics and exploratory data analysis
- Statistical hypothesis testing
- Multiple linear regression
- Logistic regression
- Weighted logistic regression
- Model evaluation using confusion matrices, sensitivity, specificity and ROC-AUC

### Research Report

[📄 View / Download Report](https://mwanja-collab.github.io/Mwanja-Portfolio/files/Students_perfomance_report.pdf){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

# 4. Sales Performance Analysis

### Project Overview

This project analyses retail sales and profitability across different products, countries and business segments. It examines sales patterns, profit performance, discounting practices and factors associated with business profitability.

Using R, the analysis applies statistical methods to generate insights into commercial performance and support evidence-based decision-making.

### Statistical Methods

- Data cleaning and exploratory data analysis
- Descriptive statistics
- Spearman correlation analysis
- Kruskal–Wallis test
- Dunn's post-hoc test with Holm adjustment
- Multiple linear regression
- Regression diagnostics and HC3 robust standard errors

### Research Report

[📊 View Sales Performance Analysis Report](sales_performance_report.html){target="_blank"}

### Tools Used

R · RStudio · Quarto · Statistical Analysis · Regression Modelling · Data Visualisation · GitHub

### Retail Sales Performance Analysis

A statistical investigation of retail sales, profitability and business performance using R. The project examines sales patterns, customer segments, product performance, discount strategies and the factors associated with profitability using descriptive statistics, non-parametric tests, correlation analysis and multiple linear regression.

**Tools:** R, RStudio, Quarto and statistical modelling.

**Report:** [View or Download the Full PDF Report](https://mwanja-collab.github.io/Mwanja-Portfolio/Retail_Sales_Performance_Analysis.pdf)
